cases.purpose: Observe the original argv cases with bounded exact-child cleanup and controlled stubborn-child escalation.
cases.oracle: Linux procfs argument-span fields and byte-level expectations constructed from the synthetic labels, zero padding, and the original sibling bytes; the independent reference-shell child and negative byte comparisons qualify the observer.
cases.comparison: Preserve the original exact argv/procfs assertions and record each owned Popen handle, pidfd, signals, waits, pipe closure and pre-cleanup failures.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
/bin/cp /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/trace-vm-argv-r3.py ./trace-vm-argv-r3.py
/bin/chmod 0755 ./trace-vm-argv-r3.py
./trace-vm-argv-r3.py --control
cases.candidate_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
./trace-vm-argv-r3.py "$BASH"
rc=$?
exit "$rc"
cases.stdout:
short: ok
default: ok
empty: ok
long: ok
extra: ok
